title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: A Strong Umamusume

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho of the Triple Tiara tour beats out the mighty competition and takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At first, the racecourse is dead silent. Then, a delayed cacophony of cheers and applause breaks out, proving the magnitude of what Sweep Tosho has accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Sweep Tosho hadn't been racing against the ultimate hero, Zenno Rob Roy, she would never have been able to cast her ultimate racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The articles that follow the Takarazuka Kinen speak of its spectators feeling almost as if they were under a magic spell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing the word "magic" in the articles, an unusually innocent smile spreads across Sweep Tosho's face.
